name: Joe Kent
role: Former director of the National Counterterrorism Center (July 2025 to March 2026; resigned over the Iran war); Republican nominee for Washington's 3rd congressional district in 2022 and 2024; retired Army Special Forces warrant officer and former CIA paramilitary officer
summary: Joe Kent is an America First Republican who combines strong opposition to foreign wars and nation building with strict immigration enforcement, gun rights, market and states-first approaches to health care and energy, and protectionist trade aimed at China. He is pro-life but leaves abortion to the states, opposes federal health care and climate programs, and attacks a 'ruling class'. In March 2026 he resigned as counterterrorism director, saying the Iran war was begun under pressure from Israel and its American lobby.

notes:
Living: true per Wikipedia (no death recorded; still giving interviews in 2026). Positions are mainly from his 2022 platform, 2022 OPB answers and debate, a 2024 long-form interview, and 2026 statements. Joekentforcongress.com was read through the Internet Archive; joekent.com is a different person. Abortion: he once backed a federal ban (per Wikipedia) but his most recent position is states decide and no new federal law, while remaining pro-life; answered -2 on legality. Not answered because no clear position of his was found: minimum wage, unions, welfare, drugs, sex work, death penalty, surveillance, Israel statehood or aid, Ukraine borders, civil-liberties statements (his general free speech principle does not answer hate speech or media control), COVID and Fauci items (no matching statement). The Daily Chronicle reported he appeared to agree with a 'demographic replacement' question at a 2022 town hall, which his attorney disputed; the article was paywalled, so elite-replacement and ethnic-nation statements stay null. Reports of 2022 interviews with American Virtue and of a 2022 immigration moratorium were not read in primary form and are not used. Many 2026 interviews (Tucker Carlson, Shawn Ryan, Megyn Kelly, Breaking Points) focus on Iran and Israel and mostly do not match any statement. The hearing transcript was auto-captioned and mostly concerns the Signal chat, January 6 and the border.

Merged with an independent claude-haiku-5-5 audit: 8 answers taken from it, 19 agreed, 0 conflicts settled by the integrator.

claude-haiku-5-5 notes: Known answers are limited to sourced statements. Most campaign quotations come from an undated third-party compilation (guides.vote) and are marked low or medium where undated. The joekent.com and joekentforcongress.com campaign sites and the Washington State Standard and KGW debate coverage could not be opened (not found or HTTP 403). The Senate hearing transcript and the full resignation letter were not reachable. Kent's 2026 Shawn Ryan transcript is an unofficial repost; the full text was not read past the first 100,000 characters. Contested points: his claims about Israel, the Jan. 6 'political prisoners' framing, and the 2024 abortion position.
